REGIME CALL: risk-off. Rationale — (1) a live, disputed military conflict directly astride Pakistan's primary energy supply route with a documented prior track record of tripling this country's oil import bill within weeks; (2) the shock is already confirmed in the tape the desk tracks (Brent +3.3%, VIX +8.4%) and in PSX's own price action today (-1.27%, 13/87 breadth — one of the worst breadth readings possible); (3) Pakistan's own government is on record warning about remittance and import-bill vulnerability from exactly this scenario; (4) domestic buffers (reserves, IMF program, disinflation trend) are real but were built on assumptions predating this re-escalation and offer a cushion, not an offset, against a genuine energy-and-external-account shock. Under desk rules this caps new setups at 2 and restricts them to defensive/beneficiary sectors only.

favored: E&P (upstream oil & gas — direct beneficiary of higher realized crude/gas prices)

avoid: OMCs (inventory/margin and circular-debt risk from volatile, weekly-repriced fuel costs)
autos (imported-input cost + weaker consumer demand under fuel/inflation pressure)
textiles/exporters (Gulf freight-cost and input-cost exposure amid Hormuz disruption)
